snippet: # 12+ Best Cameras for Bloggers in 2024 (By Bloggers, For Bloggers!). As a photographer and blogger myself, I can’t stress enough how important the camera you choose for blogging is for your content. SO I bet your wondering, what’s the best camera for bloggers? After using multiple years of trial and error with everything from my iPhone, to a GoPro, to an APS-C, and now a full-frame mirrorless, I’m confident that the top camera for bloggers is undoubtedly the **SONY A7III.**. Read on for not only why I think the Sony a7iii is the best, but also for detailed reviews of the other best cameras for bloggers in 2021 (by bloggers!), in addition to ALL the info you need to make such an important purchase. ## The Best Camera for A Blogger: Sony A7iii. Cheaper than the Sony a7riii and boasting a MUCH better battery life than its predecessor, the Sony A7iii is a full-frame camera that is guaranteed to take your content up a notch or two and keep it there.
